name: hexa-wasm
description: Hexa hex editor engine compiled to WebAssembly: editable buffers with undo, search, hashes, binary diff, patches and transformations.

scripts.build:node: npm run build:wasm && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/node ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/hexa_wasm.wasm
scripts.build:web: npm run build:wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg/web ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/hexa_wasm.wasm && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('pkg/web/package.json', '{\"type\":\"module\"}\n')"
scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:web
